input_mode: four distinct read-only upstream result roots

unit_separation.full8760: minimum ideal local flexibility robustness distance in MW/GW

claim_boundaries: FULL8760 positive robustness distance is not actual technology build, system cost, or original fixed-portfolio feasibility PASS.
V20 Layer B/C representative chronology does not support seasonal or continuous-8760 operation claims.
Expanded CAES/H2 cases are pressure tests and do not support headline province-siting claims.
Observed-minus-optimized differences are controlled model contrasts, not historical causal estimates.
failure_policy: fail closed before plotting when any case, native status, lineage, unit, closure, physical audit, or certificate contract is incomplete or inconsistent
zero_new_storage_policy: A strict valid scenario with zero new storage is retained as an explicit scientific zero, not treated as missing data.
zero_denominator_relative_metric_policy: Absolute observed, optimized and difference values must be finite. A relative difference is NA only when its optimized denominator is exactly zero; it is never imputed as zero or used to bypass a failed absolute-value audit.
signed_robustness_contrast_policy: Observed-minus-optimized battery power and energy build contrasts are signed empirical model outputs. Their direction is never preconstrained; six-context completeness, finiteness and non-constancy are required, while the cost-penalty headline retains its positive-direction gate.
